sql: SELECT id FROM (SELECT * FROM shop.main.orders sluice_src WHERE sluice_src.tenant_id = $1) orders WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM (SELECT sluice_src.id, sluice_src.name, NULL AS email, sluice_src.tenant_id, sluice_src.created_at FROM shop.main.customers sluice_src WHERE sluice_src.tenant_id = $2) customers) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT sluice_src.id, sluice_src.name, NULL AS email, sluice_src.tenant_id, sluice_src.created_at FROM shop.main.customers sluice_src WHERE sluice_src.tenant_id = $3) c WHERE c.id = 3)
